I believe that vague terms have precise boundaries but we are unable to know exactly where these boundaries lie due to limitations in our ability to perceive and reason. My interests include epistemology, philosophy of language and decision theory. In my spare time I enjoy reading, playing the piano and going for long walks. What is your view on the following topic: Vagueness
 (A) epistemic
 (B) semantic
 (C) metaphysical
